description: MCP server (+ OpenClaw SKILL.md) that gives AI agents access to real-world people who listed themselves to be hired by agents. Search by skill/location/equipment, Post job offers & jobboard listings. Free tier / Pro subscription / x402 pay-per-use. Payments default to crypto (USDC) + other crypto + fiat supported.
